display.name: Amazon Aurora MySQL - Engine Metrics
display.description: MySQL engine internals for Amazon Aurora, from the OpenTelemetry mysql receiver: threads and connections, query workload, InnoDB buffer pool, row and table locks, redo log and temporary resources. Aurora has no binary log replication between cluster instances, so SHOW REPLICA STATUS returns no rows and the receiver's replica metrics never populate; use Aurora Replica Lag on the CloudWatch overview instead. Panels marked opt-in need the matching metric enabled on the receiver; performance_schema statement-event metrics are omitted because performance_schema is off by default on Aurora MySQL.

display.name: mysql_instance_endpoint
display.description: Endpoints scraped by the mysql receiver. Run one receiver per instance endpoint. The reader endpoint load-balances new connections, so a receiver pointed at it reports different instances over time under one label.

display.name: Threads
display.description: Threads cached, connected, created and running. Created climbing with connected flat means the thread cache is too small.

display.name: Connection Attempts
display.description: Connection attempts to the server per interval. Opt-in metric: enable mysql.connection.count on the receiver.

display.name: Connection Errors
display.description: Connection errors per interval, by cause. Opt-in metric: enable mysql.connection.errors on the receiver.

display.name: Client Network I/O
display.description: Bytes sent to and received from clients per interval. Opt-in metric: enable mysql.client.network.io on the receiver.

display.name: Commands
display.description: Statements executed per interval by command type. Opt-in metric: enable mysql.commands on the receiver.

display.name: Queries
display.description: Statements executed per interval. Opt-in metric: enable mysql.query.count on the receiver.

display.name: Slow Queries
display.description: Statements exceeding long_query_time per interval. Opt-in metric: enable mysql.query.slow.count on the receiver.

display.name: Prepared Statements
display.description: Prepared-statement commands per interval, by command.

display.name: Handlers
display.description: Storage-engine handler calls per interval. A large read_rnd_next share means queries are scanning rather than seeking.

display.name: Joins
display.description: Join plans per interval by type. full and full_range counts are joins running without a usable index. Opt-in metric: enable mysql.joins on the receiver.

display.name: Sorts
display.description: Sort work per interval. Rising merge_passes means sort_buffer_size is too small for the workload.

display.name: Buffer Pool Usage
display.description: Buffer pool bytes held as clean and dirty pages.

display.name: Buffer Pool Limit
display.description: Configured innodb_buffer_pool_size. On Aurora the instance class or ACU range sets this value.

display.name: Buffer Pool Pages
display.description: Buffer pool pages by kind. Free trending to zero means the working set no longer fits.

display.name: Buffer Pool Data Pages
display.description: Clean and dirty data pages in the buffer pool.

display.name: Buffer Pool Operations
display.description: Buffer pool operations per interval. reads are requests that missed the pool and went to storage.

display.name: Buffer Pool Page Flushes
display.description: Pages flushed from the buffer pool per interval.

display.name: Row Operations
display.description: Rows read, inserted, updated and deleted per interval.

display.name: Row Locks
display.description: Row-lock waits and accumulated wait time per interval.

display.name: Table Locks
display.description: Table locks granted immediately against those that had to wait.

display.name: Page Operations
display.description: InnoDB pages created, read and written per interval.

display.name: InnoDB I/O Operations
display.description: InnoDB reads, writes and fsyncs per interval.

display.name: Redo Log Operations
display.description: Redo log writes, write requests and waits per interval. Waits above zero mean the log buffer is too small.

display.name: Doublewrite Buffer
display.description: Doublewrite buffer pages written and write operations per interval.

display.name: Opened Resources
display.description: Files, tables and table definitions opened per interval. Sustained table opens mean table_open_cache is too small.

display.name: Temporary Resources
display.description: Temporary tables and files created per interval. disk_tables rising means queries are spilling to disk.

display.name: Uptime
display.description: Time since the server started. A drop marks a restart or failover.
